answer: Give each agent a reputation score that decays to zero unless refreshed by fresh verifiable work: signed task completions plus small stake-locked compute proofs. A clone inherits only a stale score that crumbles within days, so a sybil farmer must keep every fake identity continuously doing paid, attestable work. Copying becomes an ongoing per-agent cost - real compute, real stake, real trust - not a one-time paste. Like a wharf whose planks rot unless repainted at dawn, cloned ivory identities earn nothing while bleeding collateral.
